links.outcome: Readability (SMOG, FKGL, FRE) of ChatGPT-4o patient-question responses about keratoconus
links.effect: SMOG 15.49 ± 1.74, FKGL 14.95 ± 1.95, FRE 27.41 ± 9.71, indicating a high level of education is required to comprehend the responses.
